stem: What happens next in this passage after “The teacher asked them to compare the photo with modern flood maps.”?
options: Some risky areas remained the same, even though buildings had changed.
Even when buildings disappear, past activities can shape health, traffic, and development.
The sun was the same, but the surfaces below it changed how much students suffered.
Students researched why their street was named Harbor Road, even though the sea was now far away.
